pages.title: Ley Lines
pages.text: Beneath the Overworld run rivers of mana: $(l)ley lines$(). They are invisible, a few dozen blocks wide, and they wander for hundreds of blocks before they fade.$(br2)Every world's lines are different. Once found, a line never moves.

pages.title: Ley Sight
pages.text: A $(l)Divination$() spell, and the only way to see them.$(br2)For 15 seconds, glowing blue dust marks every line around you, and you sense how strong the current is where you stand, and where it runs strongest nearby.$(br2)Upgrades widen the search and lengthen the sight.

pages.title: What They Give
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Rituals$() cost less mana when the altar stands on a line, up to half at its heart.$(li)$(l)Mana Batteries$() fill on their own, up to 2 mana a second.$(li)$(l)Mages$() standing in a strong current regenerate mana faster.$(br2)Build your workshop on a ley line.
